request:
Source ticket: MAG-14 — https://linear.app/magus-monitor/issue/MAG-14/startend-battery-percentage

Please create the columns `start_battery_pct and end_battery_pct on the database table supercharger_sessions.`

Check if there is a way to know what's the start/end battery percentage . *Base on the API response* when fetching supercharger sessions data. Maybe based on the energy added? 

grill me about that

decisions.decision: Start/end SOC is estimated by solving (energy ⇒ delta, duration ⇒ taper integral), never read from the API
decisions.why: The dx/charging/history payload has no SOC field — verified against the captured response, where every key is already mapped by ChargingSessionTesla. Duration supplies the second equation, making the pair solvable.

decisions.decision: telemetry stores only the human-owned trio (start_battery_pct, end_battery_pct, battery_pct_source); it is excluded from UpsertSuperchargerSession's ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET
decisions.why: The poller re-upserts nightly because billing mutates post-session. Including the trio would silently overwrite the user's verified values on the next poll.

decisions.decision: The estimator lives in internal/battery and computes on read; no _est columns are persisted. Reads serve verified ?? estimated
decisions.why: battery → telemetry is one-directional, so telemetry calling the estimator would be an import cycle. battery already owns packCapacityKWh and consumes telemetry.SuperchargerReader. A persisted estimate also goes stale when the taper model improves.

decisions.decision: The verification UI is out of scope for RM27 — deferred to a follow-up ticket (backlog entry 11)
decisions.why: Keeps the roadmap to two modules. Estimates are visible on the Supercharger stats page from day one, so the feature ships value without the edit form.

decisions.decision: Ran the config.yaml-mandated grill-me pass before authoring any artifact, and it overturned the ticket's premise
decisions.why: MAG-14 asked to derive SOC from the API response. Grilling against the captured payload disproved that, and surfaced the import cycle and the nightly-upsert clobber — both design-breaking if found later.

decisions.decision: Database design gate CONFIRMED for tier 1, with one revision: add start_battery_pct_est / end_battery_pct_est as a frozen snapshot written once at human verification (R8)
decisions.why: The user wants a permanent drift log (model said 82, human said 79). A dated observation is supposed to never change, so freezing does not reintroduce R6's staleness objection.

decisions.decision: Accepted the worker's escalation of R3 — the columns are omitted from UpsertSuperchargerSession's INSERT list too, not merely from ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET
decisions.why: A column appearing nowhere in the query leaves no pattern for a later careless edit to imitate. Strictly stronger than R3's literal wording at no cost.

decisions.decision: battery_pct_source stores ('user_verified','polled') and never 'estimated'; absence of the trio is the estimated signal
decisions.why: Admitting 'estimated' as storable invites a future writer to persist the live estimate, the exact anti-pattern R6 forbids. Verify-queue reads WHERE start_battery_pct IS NULL.

decisions.decision: Added tier 3 (gateway) wiring gateway → battery read-only, after the leader's claim that tiers 1+2 would show visible value was found false
decisions.why: internal/battery is imported by no package, and the Supercharger Stats page reads telemetry directly. Tiers 1+2 would compute estimates nothing renders. R7's original rationale was corrected.

decisions.decision: Owner approved starting tier 2 (battery estimator) and chose to /clear before it begins
decisions.why: Tier boundary is the cheapest checkpoint: a fresh session re-reads two progress files instead of carrying tier 1's context into every later request.

decisions.decision: RM27 descoped to tier 1 only — estimator (tier 2) and gateway display (tier 3) cancelled; the five columns are kept as-is, no drop migration
decisions.why: Owner judged the estimation work disproportionate to a ticket that asked only for the columns. Keeping the _est pair costs nothing (always NULL, never written) and avoids two migrations. Supersedes R4/R5/R7/R9.
